info.name: TCSS-460 Message API - Complete Test Collection
info.description:
Complete random data generation collection for the TCSS-460 Message API with full endpoint coverage.

**Features:**
- Uses Postman's built-in random variables
- Custom random priority generator (1-3)
- Tests for ALL API endpoints including pagination
- Collection variables store generated data for reference

**Setup Instructions:**
1. Import this collection into Postman
2. Create an environment with variable `baseUrl` set to `http://localhost:8000`
3. Run 'Generate API Key' request first to get authentication token
4. Use Collection Runner for bulk data generation

**New in this version:**
- GET /message/{name} and GET /protected/message/{name}
- Paginated endpoints (page-based and offset-based)
- Comprehensive test coverage for all routes
